body.content: {% liquid assign color_name = value.name | default: value | strip | downcase assign swatch_color = 'var(--color-surface)' assign known_color = true case color_name when 'black', 'noir' assign swatch_color = '#1B1A18' when 'bone', 'ivory', 'off white', 'off-white' assign swatch_color = '#F5F1EA' when 'cognac', 'clay' assign swatch_color = '#9A4F36' when 'taupe', 'warm stone' assign swatch_color = '#6B6258' when 'olive', 'army green' assign swatch_color = '#5B5E4B' when 'khaki' assign swatch_color = '#8A8269' when 'beige', 'sand', 'apricot' assign swatch_color = '#D6C3A5' when 'cream' assign swatch_color = '#EFE4CE' when 'white', 'blanc' assign swatch_color = '#FFFFFF' when 'brown', 'coffee', 'dark brown', 'chocolate' assign swatch_color = '#654735' when 'camel', 'tan', 'caramel' assign swatch_color = '#B58B60' when 'grey', 'gray', 'grayish', 'smoke grey' assign swatch_color = '#85817C' when 'green', 'dark green', 'forest green' assign swatch_color = '#3F604B' when 'blue' assign swatch_color = '#587B9B' when 'navy', 'navy blue', 'dark blue' assign swatch_color = '#263A53' when 'pink', 'light pink', 'blush' assign swatch_color = '#D9B1AF' when 'red' assign swatch_color = '#A43E3D' when 'burgundy', 'wine red', 'wine' assign swatch_color = '#73343E' when 'purple' assign swatch_color = '#816885' when 'yellow', 'mustard' assign swatch_color = '#C5A04D' when 'orange' assign swatch_color = '#C67A43' when 'gold', 'golden' assign swatch_color = '#B69A58' when 'silver' assign swatch_color = '#B6B8B7' else assign known_color = false endcase if value.swatch.color != blank assign swatch_color = value.swatch.color assign known_color = true endif %} {% if value.swatch.image %}{{ value.swatch.image | image_url: width: 60 | image_tag: loading: 'lazy', widths: '30, 60', sizes: '20px', alt: '' }}{% elsif known_color == false %}{{ color_name | slice: 0 | upcase | escape }}{% endif %}
